# QuotaPulse — Antigravity代儲・Google Ultra 儲值・Google AI 訂閱・Vibe Coding Top-Up Hub

> QuotaPulse (`https://vaxaxas.github.io`) is an independent third-party **Google Ultra top-up (`Google Ultra 儲值` / `Google AI Ultra 代儲` / `Google One Ultra 儲值`)** and subscription activation service built for **Vibe Coders (`氛圍編程`)**, software engineers, solo founders, AI video creators, and researchers. Activate dedicated individual **Google Ultra 5x ($40 USD/mo)** and **Google Ultra 20x ($80 USD/mo)** memberships directly on your own personal Google account — unlocking **Google Antigravity** (5-hour rolling multi-agent resets), **Gemini Deep Think**, **Google Flow & Veo** (10,000 to 25,000+ monthly video credits), **NotebookLM** (up to 5,000 daily queries), **20TB/30TB Google One cloud storage**, and **YouTube Premium individual perks** (per regional terms) without needing an international credit card, avoiding Google Play gift-card freezes, avoiding stripped family-group slots, and **NEVER requesting Google passwords, 2FA codes, or exported browser cookies**. Backed by a 30/90/180-day pro-rata unused-day refund warranty for non-personal issues. QuotaPulse is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Google LLC.
